timeline.message:
Don't catch Throwable in InternalLoggerFactory

Motivation:

We shouldnt catch Throwable in InternalLoggerFactory as this may hide OOME etc.

Modifications:

Only catch LinkageError and Exception

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/10857
timeline.author: Norman Maurer

timeline.body:
Motivation:

We shouldnt catch Throwable in InternalLoggerFactory as this may hide OOME etc.

Modifications:

Only catch LinkageError and Exception

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/10857
Found a small style error, but otherwise ok.
This can catch the more specific `(ReflectiveOperationException | SecurityException ignore)` unless for some reason `Slf4JLoggerFactory` is throwing java.lang.Exception.

reply.body: @elharo I did decide to use `Exception` as `ReflectiveOperationeException` not exists in JDK6 :/
Netty still supports JDK 6? Impressive. In that case, please add a comment to that effect here for anyone who reads this code in the future. And then LGTM.
